name: rock-esp32-bringup
title_zh: 板子不亮先查供电再查日志的 ESP32-P4 上电排
tagline_zh: 从零编译、烧录、盯串口，到识别 JC4880P443C 板载外设与 C6 协处理 Wi-Fi。
tagline_en: From zero to flashing and monitoring on the JC4880P443C board, with C6 Wi-Fi setup and fault hints—saves hours of.
desc_en: Bring up, build, flash, monitor, and troubleshoot the Rock ESP32 firmware on the JC4880P443C_I_W ESP32-P4 board. Use for ESP-IDF work, board detection, ESP-Hosted Wi-Fi through the companion ESP32-C6, or early DC-016 device firmware in this repository.
why_zh: 把分散在 ESP-IDF、板级文档和仓库里的 bring-up 步骤收成一条可复现命令链。
why_en: Turns scattered ESP-IDF and board notes into one repeatable command flow, with targeted diagnostics when hardware misbehaves—no.
limit_zh: 只认 JC4880P443C_I_W 这一块板子和本仓库固件；不碰其他 ESP32-P4 板卡。
limit_en: Only for JC4880P443C_I_W board and this repo's firmware; no other P4 boards, no host driver setup; serial permissions are on you.
title_en: ESP32-P4 bring-up troubleshooter: build, flash, log, fix
